question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 18 days and 12 days, respectively. They work on alternate days till the work gets completed. How long (in days) would it take A and B to complete the work, starting with A on the first day?
solution: Given: A can do a piece of work in 18 days B can do a piece of work in 12 days Formula Used: Efficiency = Total work/No. of days Calculation: Total work be ( L.C.M of 18, 12) be 36 unit.
